name: nextflow_workflow
description: Nextflow workflow is a cross-domain reproducible-workflow primitive for building, running, configuring, and debugging Nextflow and nf-core pipelines. Use it for DSL2 processes, channels, modules, samplesheets, container profiles, HPC/cloud execution, resume behavior, and nf-core-compliant development.
capabilities: Plan runs of existing nf-core or custom Nextflow pipelines.
Capture DSL2 workflow, process, channel, module, and configuration constraints.
Specify local, HPC, cloud, container, Conda, Docker, Singularity, or Apptainer execution profiles.
Use pinned revisions, test profiles, tracing, reports, and resume behavior for reproducibility.
requirements: Java-compatible Nextflow runtime and a selected execution backend.
Pinned pipeline revision, profiles, parameters, and samplesheets for real runs.
Container or environment strategy for each process.
